card.name: Start of sedation and toxic words
card.fires_on: The first piece of the word sedative, sedation or nonsedating ("sed", "ed"), and the word "toxic" before a condition term. Seen in drug-label text on sedation and CNS depression.

modes.label: Sedation words
modes.description: The "sed" or "ed" piece at the start of sedative, sedation or nonsedating.
modes.example: reversal of the<< sed>>ative effects of benzodiazepines

modes.label: Toxic before a condition
modes.description: The word "toxic" right before a condition such as CNS depression or neuritis.
modes.example: Severe<< toxic>> central nervous system depression or comatose

card.plain: It lights up on the start of the word sedative or sedation, and on the word toxic before a condition.
